_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_AdvancedSlide: Instead of sneaking on entry, keep holding the button to enter sneaking. If you don't, you can keep sprinting after a slide.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_AutoParkour: 'Steps' & 'Grab' will trigger automatically when a ledge is valid. 'Vault' will trigger automatically when moving with auto move.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_CrouchSlide: Press sneak while sprinting to do 'Crouch Slide'. Press sneak right after jumping to do 'Jump Slide'.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_Delay: Buffer parkour input. Using a non-zero delay with the 'Jump Preset Key' buffers the jump until threshold is passed. Tap to jump, hold to parkour.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_Indicator: Show ledge indicators for Ledges & Vaultables. Red indicates not having enough stamina.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_MustHaveStamina: In case of insufficient stamina, 'High' & 'Highest' climbing actions will play a 'Fail' animation instead. Disabling this will turn stamina system into more of a cosmetic feature.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_OnOff: Approach a ledge and press the parkour key to perform a parkour action. Hold the key midair to grab ledges.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_PlaybackSpeed: Change the animation playback speed multiplier. This doesn't affect slide / roll.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_Roll: Hold sneak midair to do 'Landing Roll'. Landing roll is tied to the stamina system and will 'Require Stamina'.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_SlideTackle: Ragdoll NPCs while sliding. Disabled by default.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_SmartClimb: 'High' & 'Highest' climb will only work when your movement speed is low. Also applies to 'Fail' if 'Must Have Stamina' option is enabled.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_SmartSteps: Allow 'Steps' to work while standing still.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_StaminaCost: Base consumption value (x). Formula is x + (Equipment Weight) * 0.2. The more items you equip, the higher the cost is.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_StaminaSystem: Parkour actions consume stamina. 'High' & 'Highest' consume full, 'Medium', 'Low', 'Vault' consume half the stamina damage option. 'Grab' & 'Steps' do not consume stamina.
line:menu_translation/skyparkour:SkyPark.$MCM_Info_UsePresetKey: Use a key from game's control map. Allows seamless keyboard/gamepad transition. Custom key doesn't support this feature.
